# Integrate AI

n8n lets you build AI workflows that connect different LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, add tools and memory, and combine several models in one workflow.

## In this section

* [MCP servers](mcp-servers.md): connect an AI agent to an MCP registry server in one click.
* [Understand AI components](understand-ai-components/): learn about agents, chains, tools, memory, and vector databases.
* [LangChain in n8n](langchain-in-n8n.md): understand how n8n implements LangChain concepts.
* [Test and improve AI workflows](test-and-improve-ai-workflows/): use evaluations to build reliable AI workflows.
* [AI examples](ai-examples/): example workflows and use cases for building AI functionality.

See [Build](../) for other workflow-building topics.
